_doc: R14.13 per-leaf review verdicts — DURABLE BASELINE for review.html. Seeded EMPTY on 2026-08-31 so the baseline is tracked from the first verdict rather than after the first loss. review.html re-reads this on boot and reports how many verdicts are not yet on disk. ⚠️ NOT a gold file: it records whether a HUMAN LOOKED at a leaf and what they concluded, never box geometry. Box corrections go through 'export corrections'.
